data.one_liner: PMTiles tile provider for flutter_map supporting local or hosted files.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TileProvider for flutter_map that enables rendering tiles from a single PMTiles file using HTTP Range Requests. It supports loading sources from URLs, local file system paths, or a direct PmTilesArchive.
use_when: You are building a flutter_map application and want to render map tiles from PMTiles files.
You need to request tiles from a single local or hosted file via HTTP Range Requests.
avoid_when: You are using mapping libraries other than flutter_map.
You do not use PMTiles archives for your map data.
strengths: Allows serving map tiles from a single local or hosted file.
Integrates smoothly with flutter_map via TileLayer.
weaknesses: Limited to flutter_map and PMTiles archives.
Requires awaiting a future to initialize the tile provider.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_map and flutter_map_pmtiles to dependencies in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use standard tile providers or built-in mapping options instead of PMTiles.
